WITH grp AS (
 SELECT member_id, 'holdout' g FROM campaign_holdout WHERE campaign_id=15
 UNION ALL
 SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id, 'targeted' FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=e.member_key WHERE e.campaign_id=15),
sales AS (
 SELECT m.member_id, sum(f.net_amount) net_all, sum(f.net_amount) FILTER (WHERE NOT f.staff_purchase_flag) net_nostaff, count(*) FILTER (WHERE f.staff_purchase_flag) staff_lines, count(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) rc
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=f.member_key
 WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-11-24' AND DATE '2025-11-30' GROUP BY 1),
ret AS (
 SELECT m.member_id, sum(r.refund_net) refund FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=r.member_key
 WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-11-24' AND DATE '2025-11-30' GROUP BY 1)
SELECT g.g, count(*) n, count(s.member_id) buyers, sum(coalesce(s.net_all,0)) net_all, sum(coalesce(s.net_nostaff,0)) net_nostaff, sum(coalesce(s.staff_lines,0)) staff_lines, sum(coalesce(r.refund,0)) refund,
 sum(coalesce(s.net_all,0))/count(*) avg_all, sum(coalesce(s.net_nostaff,0))/count(*) avg_nostaff, (sum(coalesce(s.net_nostaff,0))-sum(coalesce(r.refund,0)))/count(*) avg_nostaff_netret
FROM grp g LEFT JOIN sales s USING(member_id) LEFT JOIN ret r USING(member_id) GROUP BY g.g

 UNION ALL

cur AS (SELECT m.* FROM dim_member m WHERE DATE '2025-11-24' BETWEEN valid_from AND valid_to),

SELECT g.g, count(*) n, avg(coalesce(pre.s,0)) pre_avg, count(pre.member_id)*1.0/count(*) pre_buyer_share,
 avg(date_diff('day', c.join_date, DATE '2025-11-24')) tenure_days,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE c.tier='Basic')*1.0/count(*) basic, count(*) FILTER (WHERE c.tier='Silver')*1.0/count(*) silver, count(*) FILTER (WHERE c.tier='Gold')*1.0/count(*) gold,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE c.home_store_id=900)*1.0/count(*) online
FROM grp g JOIN cur c USING(member_id) LEFT JOIN pre USING(member_id) GROUP BY g.g

calls.statement:
WITH grp AS (
  SELECT member_id, 'holdout' AS grp FROM campaign_holdout WHERE campaign_id = 15
  UNION ALL
  SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id, 'targeted' FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = e.member_key WHERE e.campaign_id = 15
),
spend AS (
  SELECT m.member_id, sum(f.net_amount - coalesce(r.refund_net, 0)) AS net_spend
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = f.member_key
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT sales_line_id, sum(refund_net) AS refund_net FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1) r ON r.sales_line_id = f.sales_line_id
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-11-24' AND DATE '2025-11-30' AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag
  GROUP BY 1
),
per_group AS (
  SELECT g.grp, count(*) AS members, sum(coalesce(s.net_spend, 0)) / count(*) AS avg_spend
  FROM grp g LEFT JOIN spend s USING (member_id) GROUP BY g.grp
)
SELECT 15 AS campaign_id, 'Black Week 2025' AS campaign_name,
  round(max(avg_spend) FILTER (WHERE grp = 'targeted'), 2) AS avg_spend_targeted_eur,
  round(max(avg_spend) FILTER (WHERE grp = 'holdout'), 2) AS avg_spend_holdout_eur,
  round(max(avg_spend) FILTER (WHERE grp = 'targeted') - max(avg_spend) FILTER (WHERE grp = 'holdout'), 2) AS uplift_eur,
  max(avg_spend) FILTER (WHERE grp='targeted') - max(avg_spend) FILTER (WHERE grp='holdout') AS uplift_raw,
  max(members) FILTER (WHERE grp='targeted') tn, max(members) FILTER (WHERE grp='holdout') hn
FROM per_group
